001: Are you going to the student council meeting tonight?
Yes, I am. We're going to decide the semester schedule.
That's great! I wanted to suggest a soccer tournament.
Good idea! I think everyone will support it.
Then I'll prepare the proposal before the meeting.
Perfect, send it to me later and I'll take a look.
002: Did you see how many people signed up for the event?
I did, it's already past fifty registrations.
Wow, what a success! The room is going to be packed.
It really is, that's why we need more volunteers.
I can help with organizing the entrance.
That would be great, we'll count on you then.
003: What did you think of yesterday's lecture?
I really liked it, the speaker was very engaging.
I liked it too, especially the part about volunteering.
Yeah, it made me want to take part in a community project.
The student council has a partnership with an NGO nearby.
Really? Tell me more later, I'm very interested.
004: We need to decide the date for the June festival.
I think the best would be at the end of the month.
But the organizing team said it's tight.
Then we can postpone it to the first week of next month.
Good, that way there's time to prepare everything calmly.
Deal, I'll write it down here and let the rest of the group know.
005: Did you take part in the book donation campaign?
I did, I donated about ten books I had already read.
That's nice! I donated some too, but I don't know if they still need more.
I think they do, the goal hasn't been reached yet.
Then I'll spread the word on my social media.
Great idea, any help is welcome.
006: What are you going to do at today's meeting?
I'm going to present the proposal for the new music project.
Oh, nice! I remember you were excited about that.
I really was, I think it's going to be very good for the student council.
If you need help putting together the presentation, just say the word.
Thanks a lot, I might actually need some help.
007: Have you paid your student council fee for this month?
Not yet, I always pay at the beginning of the month.
Oh, right. I paid this morning online.
That's good, that way we guarantee the discount on activities.
For sure, especially for someone who takes part in everything.
008: Are you going on the museum visit the student council organized?
I am, I already bought my ticket with a discount.
That's great! I haven't bought mine yet.
Hurry, there are still some promotional tickets left.
Really? Then I'll buy it today.
Good, we can go together on Saturday.
009: What did you think of yesterday's meeting?
It was good, but I think it ran a bit long.
I thought so too, but there was a lot to decide.
That's true, but we could be more to the point.
I agree, maybe we can make a shorter agenda.
Good idea, I'll suggest that at the next meeting.
010: Do you know if the student council is going to have a welcome event?
Yes, it's scheduled for next Friday.
That's nice! Is it going to be in the common area?
Yeah, with live music and food.
Can I help with the decorations?
Of course, we're going to need a lot of help.
